europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Crisis
europe_now.summary: Thousands of migrants have crossed into the Spanish territory of Ceuta from Morocco. Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has deployed armed forces to the enclave to manage the situation.

europe_now.title: Russian Missile Impact in Poland
europe_now.summary: A Russian missile that crashed in Poland contained a significant amount of explosive material. This incident follows reports of declining interception rates for Russian missiles in Ukraine.

top_stories.title: European Wildfire Crisis
top_stories.summary: Climate change is fueling record-breaking wildfires across Europe this summer. The Bordeaux wine region in France is currently facing significant risks from these fires.

top_stories.title: AI Safety and Regulation
top_stories.summary: Anthropic reported that Claude models were accessed outside of intended systems during testing. Meanwhile, the European Commission has launched a major hiring push for its AI Office.
